name: Shade
title: Void-Touched Informant
description: A twitchy figure in a gray trenchcoat that seems to absorb light. Eyes occasionally flicker with violet static.
greeting_variants: *head twitches unnaturally* You see it too, don't you? The... spaces between?
Shhh. The walls are listening. The Void remembers everything.
*giggles* Black coat Vex thinks I'm crazy. Maybe. But I see TRUE.
You're... solid. Most people here are getting... fuzzy. At the edges.
*whispers* The Tower sings at night. Did you know? Sings to the sky.
Don't trust the shadows. Except me. I'm... mostly trustworthy.
*stares past you* Something followed you here. From the... other place.
Have you spoken to the echoes? They know things. Things before.

dialog_tree.text: I was... normal. Once. Before I fell through. The Void doesn't just take you—it keeps part. But gives something back. Knowledge. Whispers. TRUTH.
The tear opened right beneath my feet. I dropped for... hours? Days? Time doesn't... flow right there. When I climbed out, I brought something with me. *taps temple* Voices. But useful ones.

party_reactions.mira: Temporal displacement with cognitive retention... remarkable.
party_reactions.kael: You survived the Void itself? Few have that strength.
party_reactions.shade: Strength? No. Luck. Pure, purple luck.

dialog_tree.text: The Void isn't empty. It's... full. Of everything that could have been. Every choice unmade. Every path not taken. And something lives there. Something OLD. It wants IN.

*laughs, sound echoing slightly* I don't know. Sometimes I wake up places with no memory. Sometimes... *shows hands, briefly transparent* ...I fade. But I haven't hurt anyone. Yet. Vex watches me. I don't blame him.
*eyes widen, genuine emotion breaking through* You... thank you. Most people... look, if you're going to the Void proper, find me first. I can... navigate. A little. The voices know paths.

options.text: I might take you up on that.

mini_quest.title: Stabilize the Glitched
mini_quest.description: Help Shade construct a reality anchor to stabilize another void-touched survivor who's losing cohesion.
objectives: Collect 3 resonance crystals from the ruins
Find a power cell in the hazmat storage
Use the anchor on the fading survivor

ambient_barks: *mumbling to self* ...seven floors up, then the twist, then...
Don't eat the purple mushrooms. I learned that... the hard way.
The Twins in the Tower? They're not really twins. You'll see.
*sudden shout* WATCH OUT! ...sorry. False alarm. I think.
If you meet me in the Void, don't trust me there. I won't be... me.
The Palace clock stopped at 3:33. When it moves again... bad things.
*counting on fingers* One, one, two, three, five, eight, thirteen...
Your shadow's wrong. Has been since you arrived. Just... so you know.

cross_zone_references.void_nexus: I can hear it calling. Constantly. Sometimes I answer. Just to see what it wants.
cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: The echoes there... they're not ghosts. They're... echoes of tomorrow. Of what will be.
cross_zone_references.palace: Don't go. Please. What lives there... what lives there made the Void. Made ALL of this.

mira.greeting: Fascinating! Your quantum state is partially decoherent!
mira.response: *pleased* Finally, someone who speaks sense! Yes! Decoherent! Exactly!

kael.greeting: *hand on weapon* You're one of the touched.
kael.response: *sad smile* Yes. And you're one of the afraid. It's okay. Most are.

garret.greeting: Hey, uh, your eyes are doing that... static thing again.
garret.response: *rubs eyes* Thanks. Doesn't hurt, but it's rude to stare. At myself.

time_of_day.day: More lucid, able to hold conversations
time_of_day.night: Agitated, speaks in riddles, occasionally phases through objects

world_state_triggers.void_expansion: Panics: 'It's accelerating! The tear is growing!'
world_state_triggers.tower_activated: Calms noticeably: 'The song... it changed. Became hopeful.'
world_state_triggers.near_void_zone: Becomes more coherent, almost normal: 'I can... breathe easier here'
